mapper.select:
select pick_id, max_total_score, popular_score from ( select p.id as pick_id, ( coalesce(least(match(p.title) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode), 100000) * 3.0, 0) + coalesce( (select max(least(match(po.title) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode), 100000) * 2.0) from devdevdev.pick_option po where po.pick_id = p.id), 0 ) + coalesce( (select max(least(match(po.pick_option_contents) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode), 100000)) from devdevdev.pick_option po where po.pick_id = p.id), 0 ) ) as max_total_score, p.popular_score from devdevdev.pick p where match(p.title) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode)
union
select p.id as pick_id, ( coalesce(least(match(p.title) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode), 100000) * 3.0, 0) + coalesce(max(least(match(po.title) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode), 100000) * 2.0), 0) + coalesce(max(least(match(po.pick_option_contents) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode), 100000)), 0) ) as max_total_score, p.popular_score from devdevdev.pick p inner join devdevdev.pick_option po on p.id = po.pick_id where match(po.title) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode) group by p.id, p.popular_score
union
select p.id as pick_id, ( coalesce(least(match(p.title) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode), 100000) * 3.0, 0) + coalesce(max(least(match(po.title) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode), 100000) * 2.0), 0) + coalesce(max(least(match(po.pick_option_contents) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode), 100000)), 0) ) as max_total_score, p.popular_score from devdevdev.pick p inner join devdevdev.pick_option po on p.id = po.pick_id where match(po.pick_option_contents) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode) group by p.id, p.popular_score ) as pick_search_results
(max_total_score < #{cursorSearchScore}) or ( max_total_score = #{cursorSearchScore} and popular_score < #{cursorPopularScore} ) or ( max_total_score = #{cursorSearchScore} and popular_score = #{cursorPopularScore} and pick_id < #{cursorId} )
order by max_total_score desc, popular_score desc, pick_id desc limit #{limit}
